Like a quiet friend who listens without judgment. When you have kept something inside for a long time, do not know who to tell, or cannot let go of certain feelings, use this deck to share what is troubling you and slowly find your answer.
Use it as your tree hole, sharing your thoughts and worries, with the puppet spirits guiding you through reality and dreams, gently interpreting to give direction to a confused soul!
3D figures that bring the deck to life
For when you need to open up but do not know who to talk to

A lighthearted and adorable cat-themed deck. When everyday worries or little dilemmas are on your mind, or you simply want to know what may happen soon, have a chat with the cats and see what answer they have for you.
Gently listening to your emotional confusion and daily complaints, accompanying you through every moment, with soft and healing interpretations to inject luck and warmth into your life!
Adorable kitties ready for your secrets
For when something is on your mind and you could use a little company

A timeless, well-rounded deck for all kinds of everyday readings. Whether your question is about love, school, or life, turn to this deck whenever you feel unsure or do not know which deck to choose. It can help you find answers and see your next step more clearly.
Opening this classic deck feels like stepping into a centuries-old library of wisdom. Speak freely—Tarot will put your tangled thoughts in order, and light the way forward.
The original Rider–Waite, classic and timeless
A timeless all-rounder for any question

A calm and mysterious deck for reflecting on serious questions. When you face an important decision in love, school, work, or life and worry about choosing wrong, use this deck to see what each option may bring.

Subtle, steady gold etching builds a solemn order that feels timeless. It won\'t comfort hesitation—or excuse impulse. When a decision really matters, Dark Gold Tarot offers a grounded, enduring perspective
Dark gold weight for decisions that matter
For major decisions and their long-term outcomes
Download complete. You can switch decks

A soft, dreamy tarot deck with a healing touch. When love, friendship, or life leaves you feeling sad or anxious and you cannot move past the emotion, use this deck to gently sort through your feelings and find a little comfort and direction.

Pastel blues and pinks create a cloud-soft world. Like a dream you don\'t have to wake up from yet, it helps you settle your emotions. In each draw, the anxiety softens—and your feelings and hopes become clearer
Dreamlike hues for the soft moments
For when you feel low and need emotional healing

A deck for quietly exploring your inner world. When you do not know what you truly want, or you keep going back and forth in a relationship, use this deck to understand your honest feelings and thoughts.

With the depth of a somber night sky, it traces the emotions stirring in the shadows. Eternal Night won\'t rush you for answers, nor turn away from the cramped corners of your heart. When you need solitude, self-understanding, or to find your center amidst the chaos—when you need to find your voice in the vastness of the universe—it offers a quiet, grounded, inward-looking perspective
For when you feel stuck and need to understand your heart

Like searching for answers within a collection of fables. When you do not know which option to choose, whether to keep going or let go, or where your future is headed, use this deck to see where each path may lead.

Every card feels like a paused scene from your journey—showing where you are now and what your heart is choosing. As you draw, it\'s like stepping into a quiet fable that helps you find your way, at your own pace
A fable-like world to spark imagination
For when you feel lost and do not know which path to choose
This history uses an undownloaded deck. Download to use it.

A deck filled with mystery and magic. When you cannot read someone\'s true thoughts, or you sense that a situation is not as simple as it seems, use this deck to notice what has been overlooked and uncover the answer beneath the surface.

Focuses on predicting situational variables and hidden opportunities. Suitable for exploring hidden signals in complex relationships, such as secret crush games or campus social trends. With vivid magical elements, it helps decode subtle fluctuations in situations, empowering you to take the lead and ignite your intuitive potential.
For when things feel unclear and you want the truth beneath them

A mysterious, dark, and daring tarot deck. When you want to know whether they are hiding something, what they have left unsaid, or what lies in the more private side of a relationship, use this deck to seek the answer.

Vivid crimson and shadow shapes create a trance-like space between reality and the subconscious. Midnight Tarot cuts through the surface—revealing raw feelings and desire, so the answer shows up bluntly, with no sugarcoating
For exploring desire, secrets, and unspoken truths

A simple, straightforward tarot deck that does not overcomplicate things. When you cannot decide whether to do something or which of two options to choose, use this deck to clear away the noise and see the answer more directly.
For big decisions, career or life planning, or any complex situation, it cuts through the noise and goes straight to the heart of your question, offering calm, direct guidance
Pure minimalism, clarity at a glance
For important choices when you need a clear answer

Stripping away color, it redraws the classics in raw black-and-white lines. In a vintage play of light and shadow, it quiets the noise—like a late-night talk with your soul—so you can return to the clearest answer.
Modern monochrome Rider–Waite, calm and clean

A deck made for exploring love and relationships. When you want to know whether they like you, how they truly feel, or whether the two of you could grow closer, use this deck to reveal their honest feelings and where your connection may go next.
Accurately interpreting their inner secrets, exploring hidden emotions and the possibilities of love
Soft romance for matters of the heart
Reveal their true feelings and where your relationship is heading
Unlocked, but not downloaded. Download to use.

Like a prism, this deck helps you view the same situation from different angles. When a relationship becomes harder to understand or a situation grows complicated, use it to shift your perspective and slowly make sense of what is happening.
Inspired by stained-glass cathedral windows, it refracts ancient wisdom into vivid shapes. Clean geometry makes the logic clearer—so you can zoom out, untangle the mess, and choose your next move
For when a relationship feels complicated and hard to read

Whether stuck in a \"black-and-white moment\" of internal friction or a \"colorful dream\" of breakthrough, it balances your sensibility and rationality. Suitable for divining psychological states, academic pressure, and self-improvement. It helps heal anxiety and regain control over your life rhythm amidst complex choices.
For when you are emotionally drained and stuck overthinking

Inspired by butterflies and transformation. When you have been feeling lost, something has been stuck for a while, or you are moving through a period of change, use this deck to see what is holding things back and what may unfold next.

Perfect for those going through transitions or low periods. A more direct tarot deck for looking at an issue seriously. When you are tired of guessing, do not want to hear only what feels good, and simply need to know what is really going on, use this deck to face the most honest side of the situation.

Stark linework and red-black contrast hit hard. The rough cuts feel like fate carved over and over—unafraid of desire, conflict, and real choices. It doesn\'t soothe; it clears the fog and brings you straight to what you need to face
For when you want the honest truth and heart of the issue

A deck for action and taking the initiative. When you are torn over whether to reach out, confess your feelings, or move a relationship forward, use this deck to see what may happen if you make the first move.

When you\'re facing others, facing the world, facing moments that call for you to take the first step—it offers a bright, outward, action-driven perspective
